- **Scale & Systems:** Architected 10M+ QPS real-time ML ranking systems; impacted 1B+ global users across Atlassian, Attentive, Twitter, and Amazon; led multiple 0->1 Generative AI, Generative RecSys, and Personalization organizations.
- **Research & Open Data:** 1,290+ academic citations (h-index: 13, i10-index: 14, Top 1% global impact per OpenAlex); 202,000+ cumulative dataset downloads, 1,188,000+ dataset views, and 2,270+ upvotes on Kaggle; 210+ GitHub followers and 195+ stars/forks across 29 public repositories; served across 25+ top-tier AI/ML conference program committees and editorial review boards; invited member of Meta's Research Advisory Council.
- **Teaching, Speaking, Creator Reach & Advisory (Afterdays):** Founder of **Afterdays** - AI consulting and technical education practice closely partnering with **AI Aspire** (by Andrew Ng); 50+ enterprise & startup advisory engagements (Google, Meta, Microsoft, NVIDIA, AWS, Morgan Stanley, Airtable, Glean, Salesforce, Datadog); 20+ international conference talks and corporate AI trainings; books, courses, and technical content reaching millions of developers across 165+ global markets (169 countries); 193,200+ annual organic LinkedIn impressions (70,100+ unique members reached, 4,090+ high-intent engagements, 8,280+ followers with 66% Senior+/Leadership audience across Amazon, Meta, Google, Microsoft, Apple & NVIDIA); 54+ verified 5.0/5.0 advisory and mentorship reviews across MentorCruise (16 reviews) and MeetAPro (38 reviews); 15+ global media features.

## 3. Professional Experience

### Atlassian - Principal ML Engineer / Tech Lead (Sep 2025 – Present)
- Leading Rovo & Search Quality / Generative Personalization teams (20+ engineers) across the organization.
- Architecting LLM and SLM pre-training and post-training (supervised fine-tuning, preference alignment) powering Atlassian's Rovo Agent and Atlassian Intelligence.
- Defining long-term technical strategy and 0->1 architecture for Generative RecSys & Foundation Models - leading the transition from traditional recommendation and search systems toward Foundation Models spanning representation learning, generative recommendation, personalization, training, and evaluation.

### Afterdays - Founder: AI Consulting, Enterprise Enablement & Technical Education (2021 – Present)
- **Afterdays × AI Aspire (by Andrew Ng) Partnership:** Closely partnering between Afterdays and AI Aspire (https://aiaspire.ai/ | Announcement: https://www.linkedin.com/feed/update/urn:li:activity:7515804869455278080/), Andrew Ng's AI education organization, to help enterprises and engineering organizations build practical applied ML and AI engineering skills - including delivering a **2-week corporate AI training program for Morgan Stanley** in New York, NY (Oct 2026).
- **Enterprise AI Consulting & Advisory:** 50+ high-impact consulting and advisory engagements with leaders across Google, Meta, Microsoft, NVIDIA, AWS, Morgan Stanley, Airtable, Glean, Salesforce, and Datadog; certified Top Mentor (5.0 / 5.0, 54+ verified reviews).
- **Udacity - *Advanced LLM Inference Optimization* (`cd14455`):** Production LLM inference course covering transformer KV-cache mechanics, quantization, speculative decoding, model parallelism, DeepSpeed, TensorRT-LLM, and Triton Inference Server (https://www.udacity.com/course/llm-inference-optimization--cd14455).
- **Udacity - *Intelligent Backends with RAG & Chat Models* (`nd035` Course 3: Enterprise AI & Microservices):** Enterprise AI curriculum covering LLM chat clients, tool-calling AI agents (Spring AI, LangChain4j), modular RAG pipelines, and semantic vector search with HNSW, HyDE, and re-ranking (https://www.udacity.com/course/java-developer-nanodegree--nd035).
- **LinkedIn Learning - *Building LLM-Powered Recommendation Systems*:** Hands-on course on hybrid retrieval, LLM-enhanced recommender patterns, prompt engineering, evaluation, and scalable serving (https://www.linkedin.com/learning/building-llm-powered-recommendation-systems | Companion GitHub: https://github.com/LinkedInLearning/hands-on-AI-building-LLM-powered-recommendation-systems-4014214 | Featured in the University of Florida Career Hub: https://careerhub.ufl.edu/classes/building-llm-powered-recommendation-systems/).
- **Interview Kickstart:** Featured instructor for *Applied Agentic AI* (https://interviewkickstart.com/courses/applied-agentic-ai-tech-pathway#instructors), *Building Vertical AI Agents* (https://interviewkickstart.com/masterclass/vertical-ai-agents-impact), *Building AI Agent for Retail* (https://interviewkickstart.com/masterclass/retail-ai-agent), *Agentic RAG* (https://interviewkickstart.com/ai-glossary/agentic-rag), and *Structured Prompting* (https://interviewkickstart.com/ai-glossary/structured-prompting).

### Attentive - Staff Machine Learning Engineer / Tech Lead (2023 – 2025)
- Founded and led the Personalization ML team from 0->1, overseeing 15+ engineers across 5+ product lines.
- Built and deployed deep learning recommendation and conversational commerce models (Two-Tower & Multi-Task Learning, MLP stacks, DCN, residual networks, attention, MMoE, PLE) across hundreds of millions of end-users and 8,000+ leading brands.
- Drove generative personalization applications leveraging prompt engineering, RAG architectures, and PEFT-based LLM fine-tuning grounded in deep user/item representations.
- Scaled distributed mixed-precision PyTorch training and ANN vector-store serving; authored Attentive's engineering blog *Evolving Attentive's Personalized Recommendations* (Oct 2024).

### Twitter - Senior Machine Learning Engineer / Tech Lead (Jul 2019 – 2023)
- Founding engineer of the Conversations Quality team and contributor to Home Feed Ranking.
- Built multi-task TensorFlow deep ranking models driving >30% gains in key conversation engagement metrics and 3-5% gains in reply health and author follows; filed patent on reply ranking.
- Architected KubeFlow + DataFlow + BigQuery pipelines on GCP (10x faster model training), Heterogeneous Information Network graph embeddings, fine-tuned BERT text embeddings, and a 10M+ QPS Early Ranking system (20% p9999 latency reduction, +5% health metrics).

### Amazon - Software Engineer, Machine Learning (Jul 2018 – Jul 2019) & SDE Intern (Jun – Sep 2017)
- Built ML eligibility prediction models and AWS serverless/SageMaker infrastructure for Amazon International Expansions & Exports.
- Served as Teaching Assistant at Amazon's Machine Learning University (Intro to Data Science, Text Mining) and Reviewer for Amazon's Machine Learning Conference (AMLC 2019).
- Earlier interned on the DataForge Big Data scheduling platform (Java, Hive transactionality, DynamoDB).

### University of California San Diego - Graduate Researcher & Teaching Assistant (2016 – 2018)
- Conducted ML, NLP, and Recommender Systems research in Prof. Julian McAuley's lab.
- Teaching Assistant for CSE 258 (*Recommender Systems & Web Mining*, Prof. Julian McAuley) and CSE 110 (*Software Engineering*, Prof. William Griswold).

### Arcesium (D. E. Shaw Group) - Member of Technical Staff (Jul 2015 – Jul 2016)
- Engineered fault-tolerant, low-latency post-trade financial processing infrastructure in Java/Spring/SQL Server (~40% throughput gain via concurrency and indexing).

### Indian Institute of Technology (IIT) Madras - Research Intern (Dec 2014 – May 2015)
- Developed linear-complexity Scalable Bayesian Matrix Factorization and Variational Bayesian Factorization Machines under Prof. Balaraman Ravindran.

## 6. Open-Source Benchmark Datasets (202K+ Downloads · 1.18M+ Views on Kaggle)

1. **News Category Dataset** - ~210,000 HuffPost headlines & short descriptions across 42 categories (2012–2022); 110,900+ Kaggle downloads, 585,000+ views, 890+ upvotes, 240+ academic citations.
   - Kaggle: https://www.kaggle.com/rmisra/news-category-dataset/ | Paper: https://arxiv.org/abs/2209.11429
2. **News Headlines Dataset for Sarcasm Detection** - 28,600+ sarcastic (*The Onion*) vs. non-sarcastic (*HuffPost*) headlines; 64,500+ Kaggle downloads, 379,800+ views, 1,050+ upvotes; featured in DeepLearning.AI's Coursera NLP specialization.
   - Kaggle: https://www.kaggle.com/rmisra/news-headlines-dataset-for-sarcasm-detection/ | DOI: https://doi.org/10.1016/j.aiopen.2023.01.001
3. **Clothing Fit Dataset for Size Recommendation** - ModCloth and RentTheRunway fit feedback datasets; 14,800+ Kaggle downloads, 143,400+ views, 205 upvotes.
   - Kaggle: https://www.kaggle.com/rmisra/clothing-fit-dataset-for-size-recommendation/
4. **Politifact Fact Check Dataset** - 21,152 expert fact-checked statements (2008–2022) across 6 truthfulness ratings (`DOI: 10.13140/RG.2.2.29923.22566`); 5,700+ Kaggle downloads, 33,500+ views.
   - Kaggle: https://www.kaggle.com/datasets/rmisra/politifact-fact-check-dataset
5. **IMDB Spoiler Dataset** - 570,000+ entertainment reviews labeled for plot spoilers; 6,000+ Kaggle downloads, 46,000+ views (`DOI: 10.13140/RG.2.2.11584.15362`).
   - Kaggle: https://www.kaggle.com/rmisra/imdb-spoiler-dataset
